from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseCharge(BaseModel):
    """A criminal charge mentioned in a judgment document."""
    charge_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific crime name as stated in the document")
    legal_chapter: str | None = Field(description="The chapter or category of Criminal Law this charge belongs to, if mentioned")

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document: its title, case type, and any criminal charges."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is 刑事 (criminal), 行政 (administrative), 民事 (civil), or other")
    charges: list[CaseCharge] = Field(description="All criminal charges mentioned in this document")
    matches_task_criterion: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this document explicitly states it belongs to '妨碍社会管理秩序罪' cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
